description: rl_push near-start set (user 2026-09-25: 100 mm too close, 200 mm chosen): 5 random test objects with footprint <= 110 mm and distinct categories (numpy default_rng(0) permutation of the footprint-filtered loaders sorted by loader index). Target = frame-0 object centroid + 200 mm in a random direction (same rng, uniform angle). The whole gripper is re-posed at frame 0 (gp/scene_edit.hand_start_natural) 200 mm BEHIND the object along the push line (bearing 0, no jitter), hand centroid 85 mm above the object centre, approach axis down, fingers as recorded: gripper-object distance = object-target distance = 200 mm. Push directions re-drawn (user): angle = numpy default_rng(1).uniform(0, 360) per problem in order. GOAL ONLY (user): upright_weight 0, contact_weight 0; the objective is the object-centroid distance to the target at task frame 40.
simulator: Isaac floating hand (gp/replay/isaac_float.py, rl_push CoACD hulls, density 500, friction 1.0)
